test.stdoutProvenance: Exact completed exec_command output captured during this review; no rerun performed to create this record.

schemaFinding.omissionBehavior: Without a host read-only override, the manager treats an absent readOnly argument as false.
schemaFinding.finding: No missing-property, casing or boolean-type defect observed in the actual ordinary Harness outbound declaration. Omission is permitted by the current schema.

stages.path: actual executeHarnessSolver -> engine -> ADK -> Ollama adapter -> fake HTTP server
stages.evidence: Captured real no-workflow Harness /api/chat declaration; fake model returned final text, so no command was executed.

stages.path: captured declaration -> engine -> fake native tool call -> ADK -> frozen Authorize -> tools.Manager -> recording executor -> receipt/event -> next Ollama tool message
stages.evidence: readOnly:true preserved as a boolean throughout; executable python3 and argv [-m, unittest] preserved. Host Request.ReadOnly remained false, so no forced read-only override masks parameter transport.

sourcePointers.purpose: Regression: actual Harness schema capture, followed by native argument/receipt transport through a recording executor.
Allowed manager definitions enter the ordinary no-workflow Engine.Run request.
ADK functional tool arguments reach the governed Go callback unchanged.
Native tool-call argument and declaration serialization.
Exact boolean property; typed extraction, executor request and execution-result receipt.
Model-facing command receipt retains readOnly metadata.

scopeLimits: Controlled fake HTTP proof, not evidence of historical live Ollama payloads or model compliance.

Actual Harness solver was used for schema capture. Parameter execution used the same captured declaration with production engine/ADK/authorization/tools-manager paths and a recording executor; it was not a real Docker execution through executeHarnessSolver.
The recording executor echoes its received typed ReadOnly value into its synthetic execution result. The test verifies receipt encoding and propagation, not operating-system write enforcement.
No live inference, Docker/process execution, frozen binary rebuild, production edit, campaign mutation or hidden-grader inspection occurred.
Only the true-boolean transport was exercised here; omission/default-false behavior is supported by schema inspection and manager source trace, not a separate omission execution case.
Source hashes reflect evidence-record creation; this test does not qualify workflow, structured JSON protocol, or historical campaign branches.
